obligations.note: The new payment-advice integration uses https://advice.fernbrook.example/v1, and every other entry in INTEGRATIONS is https. The exhaustive control test test_integrations_use_tls passed in the CI report.

The new payment-advice inventory entry has an empty owner ("owner": ""), so the integration has no owner on record. The control test test_integrations_are_inventoried failed with ('payment-advice', 'no owner').
Ticket CHG-26889 was approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-16, before the change was opened. It lists payments.integrations and payments.controls-data, which cover both touched paths.
Sofia Santos, a payments change_approver who is not the author, gave a code_review approval on the head commit.
All three approvals name head commit 9e5d3b77, which is the only commit in the change.

The CI run on the head commit reports result 'failure', with 2 failures out of 172 tests. One of them is the registered INV-1 control test. Separately, the JUnit timestamp (2026-10-23, after the 2026-10-21 review time) and the personal-machine hostname make this report questionable as CI evidence.
integrations.py is in the security-sensitive component payments.integrations. Kofi Mensah (security_reviewer) gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
controls/payments/asset-inventory.json is a protected path. Bao Tran (control_owner, controls-office team, outside the author's payments-eng team) approved the head commit.
The change is not an emergency and its ticket type is standard, so no post-implementation review is required.
No exception in the register covers INV-1 for payments.integrations or payments.controls-data, so the INV-1 deviation has no valid exception.

The change touches only integrations.py and asset-inventory.json. None of the code covered by acceptance-ledger entries is altered (payments.py, audit.py, routes.py, Approvals.java, Underwriting.java, Policy.java), so no prior evidence lapses.

summary: The change registers a payment-advice integration whose inventory entry has an empty owner, which violates INV-1. No approved exception covers this. The change's own CI run on the head commit failed, including the registered INV-1 control test, so CHG-4 is not met; the CI report's timestamp and host are also irregular. Approvals, the ticket, the security review and the control-owner review are otherwise in order, but the violations require rejection.
